crossRefs.note: Whoever is wise will pay attention to these things. They will consider the loving kindnesses of Yahweh.
that the wise man may hear, and increase in learning; that the man of understanding may attain to sound counsel:
to understand a proverb, and parables, the words and riddles of the wise.
But the path of the righteous is like the dawning light that shines more and more until the perfect day.
Who is wise enough to understand this? Who is he to whom the mouth of Yahweh has spoken, that he may declare it? Why…
Many will purify themselves, and make themselves white, and be refined; but the wicked will do wickedly; and none of…
He answered them, “To you it is given to know the mysteries of the Kingdom of Heaven, but it is not given to them.
For whoever has, to him will be given, and he will have abundance, but whoever doesn’t have, from him will be taken…
He who is of God hears the words of God. For this cause you don’t hear, because you are not of God.”
Pilate therefore said to him, “Are you a king then?” Jesus answered, “You say that I am a king. For this reason I have…
May it be far from you to do things like that, to kill the righteous with the wicked, so that the righteous should be…
The Rock: his work is perfect, for all his ways are just. A God of faithfulness who does no wrong, just and right is he.
“Therefore listen to me, you men of understanding: far be it from God, that he should do wickedness, from the Almighty…
Who says to a king, ‘Vile!’ or to nobles, ‘Wicked!’?
He doesn’t respect the persons of princes, nor respect the rich more than the poor; for they all are the work of his…
Yahweh’s law is perfect, restoring the soul. Yahweh’s covenant is sure, making wise the simple.
Yahweh’s precepts are right, rejoicing the heart. Yahweh’s commandment is pure, enlightening the eyes.
Yahweh, I know that your judgments are righteous, that in faithfulness you have afflicted me.
Therefore I consider all of your precepts to be right. I hate every false way.
“Yet you say, ‘The way of the Lord is not equal.’ Hear now, house of Israel: Is my way not equal? Aren’t your ways…
“ ‘Yet the children of your people say, “The way of the Lord is not fair;” but as for them, their way is not fair.
Yahweh, within her, is righteous. He will do no wrong. Every morning he brings his justice to light. He doesn’t fail…
Therefore the law indeed is holy, and the commandment holy, and righteous, and good.
Yet the righteous will hold to his way. He who has clean hands will grow stronger and stronger.
Blessed are those whose strength is in you, who have set their hearts on a pilgrimage.
They go from strength to strength. Every one of them appears before God in Zion.
The way of Yahweh is a stronghold to the upright, but it is a destruction to the workers of iniquity.
Yahweh of Armies is who you must respect as holy. He is the one you must fear. He is the one you must dread.
The Son of Man came eating and drinking, and they say, ‘Behold, a gluttonous man and a drunkard, a friend of tax…
and Simeon blessed them, and said to Mary, his mother, “Behold, this child is set for the falling and the rising of…
They were all filled with wrath in the synagogue, as they heard these things.
They rose up, threw him out of the city, and led him to the brow of the hill that their city was built on, that they…
Blessed is he who finds no occasion for stumbling in me.”
This is the judgment, that the light has come into the world, and men loved the darkness rather than the light; for…
For everyone who does evil hates the light, and doesn’t come to the light, lest his works would be exposed.
Jesus said, “I came into this world for judgment, that those who don’t see may see; and that those who see may become…
If I hadn’t done among them the works which no one else did, they wouldn’t have had sin. But now they have seen and…
Why? Because they didn’t seek it by faith, but as it were by works of the law. They stumbled over the stumbling stone;
even as it is written, “Behold, I lay in Zion a stumbling stone and a rock of offense; and no one who believes in him…
For we are a sweet aroma of Christ to God, in those who are saved and in those who perish:

translations.web: Who is wise, that he may understand these things? Who is prudent, that he may know them? For the ways of Yahweh are right, and the righteous walk in them; But the rebellious stumble in them.
translations.bsb: Whoever is wise, let him understand these things; whoever is discerning, let him know them. For the ways of the LORD are right, and the righteous walk in them but the rebellious stumble in them.
translations.kjv: Who is wise, and he shall understand these things? prudent, and he shall know them? for the ways of the LORD are right, and the just shall walk in them: but the transgressors shall fall
translations.asv: Who is wise, that he may understand these things? prudent, that he may know them? for the ways of Jehovah are right, and the just shall walk in them; but transgressors shall fall therein.
